sections.title: WHAT IS THE DATA HUB?
sections.body: The BCRF Global Data Hub is a centralized research portal of breast cancer studies with molecular and clinical data to foster data sharing, analysis, new studies and collaboration.

sections.title: WE'RE OPEN
sections.body: The Hub is open to BCRF investigators, amassing all relevant datasets from BCRF-supported studies around the world. Data will be invited from and made available to the wider breast cancer community—to ultimately impact all breast cancer research—in 2025 and beyond.

columns.title: ABOUT THE DATA HUB
columns.body: A first-of-its-kind data sharing network dedicated to breast cancer, poised to radically transform how scientists access and share research findings.

columns.title: ABOUT THE PARTNERSHIP
columns.body: Together, BCRF's unparalleled global network of leading researchers and the University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine, a leader in biomedical informatics, provide a revolutionary combination of expertise.
